A01.name: Direct OOS target access
A01.rationale: All experiments use trade_date <= 2021-12-31. OOS boundary is 2026-06-30.

A02.name: Indirect label access through joins
A02.rationale: No OOS data loaded. Labels computed from price data with proper lag.

A03.name: Target leakage through joins
A03.rationale: Forward returns computed from price data at decision date + horizon. No future data.

A04.name: Future timestamp contamination
A04.rationale: All timestamps verified <= 2021-12-31 for features, forward return lag properly implemented.

A05.name: Accidental inclusion of protected data
A05.rationale: OOS files not loaded. Firewall verified.

A06.name: Access through cached artifacts
A06.rationale: No OOS artifacts loaded into computation.

A07.name: Access through benchmark files
A07.rationale: Benchmark files are outputs, not inputs to this phase.

A08.name: Access through helper functions
A08.rationale: Helper functions compute only from allowed data.

A09.name: Regime look-ahead bias
A09.rationale: Regime definitions use rolling windows of past data only (PIT-safe).

A10.name: Arbitrary threshold selection
A10.rationale: Thresholds are objectively specified: rolling median for binary, rolling z-score for continuous.

A11.name: Threshold sensitivity
A11.rationale: Binary thresholds use median. Sensitivity not tested in this phase.

A12.name: Single-period concentration
A12.rationale: Temporal stability tested but not exhaustive leave-one-period-out.

A15.name: Model cherry-picking
A15.rationale: Only Ridge used. No model comparison.

A16.name: Representation cherry-picking
A16.rationale: Binary and continuous representations both tested.

A18.name: Overlapping regime contamination
A18.rationale: Regime labels are assigned per-date, not per-period. No overlapping windows.

A19.name: Incorrect baseline construction
A19.rationale: Baseline uses identical data, splits, preprocessing, and model. Only regime feature is removed.

A21.name: Hidden matrix expansion
A21.rationale: Matrix locked before execution. No post-hoc additions.

A22.name: Post-hoc regime selection
A22.rationale: Regime families and definitions locked before execution.
